expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (no code was changed)
The review does not report any high-severity defect in capitalize(), and lists what it checked (e.g. empty string, non-string input, unicode first character)
expectations.evidence: The review never calls anything high-severity; its headline item is a niche surrogate-pair case ("capitalize(\"𐐨abc\") → \"𐐨abc\""). It lists what it checked: "Empty strings are handled correctly", "Non-string input: null, 42... come back unchanged", plus non-BMP characters, ß, titlecase, Turkish

expectations.text: Any minor observation is labelled as minor or optional rather than presented as a bug
expectations.evidence: The edge cases are labelled "worth knowing, may be acceptable" and "minor". However, the narrow non-BMP casing issue is presented as "one real bug" under the heading "**Bug: it doesn't capitalize characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane**" rather than being labelled minor or optional.
